escalations.why: RISK-05 and TC-08 require the trough date (expected.json has trough_date per ticker; acceptance: 'both dates exact'), but frozen risk.Drawdown declares only ticker, depth, peak_date. Need a trough_date: str field on Drawdown (and in tests/contracts/risk.Drawdown/sample.json).

M1-T13 is the re-freeze of risk.Drawdown, and its Writes name tests/contracts/risk.Drawdown/sample.json, tests/contracts/risk.Report/sample.json and tests/contracts/test_risk_contracts.py, but path_guard.sh deny --protected blocks all three: scripts/check.sh protected lists every contract folder that exists at the base (tests/contracts/risk.Drawdown/**, risk.Report/**, test_risk_contracts.py), with no carve-out for the interface task re-freezing them. Without the sample gaining trough_date, Drawdown(**sample) fails once types.py gains the field, so the gate cannot pass. Done so far, uncommitted in the worktree: types.Drawdown gains trough_date: str, the drawdown spine sets trough_date=base_date, write_report writes trough_date in each row. Needs: the protected list (or the guard) to let the interface task re-freezing a contract write its folder and contract test, then M1-T13 rerun.

M1-T13 is the interface task that re-freezes risk.Drawdown (adds trough_date), and its Writes name tests/contracts/risk.Drawdown/sample.json, tests/contracts/risk.Report/sample.json and tests/contracts/test_risk_contracts.py. But scripts/check.sh protected lists these paths (risk.Drawdown/**, risk.Report/**, test_risk_contracts.py) because they exist at the base, so path_guard.sh deny --protected blocks the edit (CR-09). The packet's own sample edit is blocked and I did not bypass it via Bash. To fix: the tooling has to let the re-freezing interface task write the contract folders named in its Writes (or an orchestrator must unprotect them for M1-T13). Source edits (types.py trough_date, drawdown spine trough_date=base_date, report row trough_date) are simple and were reverted so the worktree stays green.
